title: The Press Conference Without the Human
role: Main plot · Central set piece · Separates simulation from reality

believed.leonardo: Announcing a compelling future is the point; it is a creative work.
believed.borges: An announcement must be traceable to evidence.
believed.agnolo: Projected outcomes cannot be announced as results.
believed.simulated-human: The future it carries is the one that happened.

starting_positions.borges: Wants whatever is announced to be traceable to something established.
starting_positions.agnolo: Wants a standard for what counts as a truthful announcement before anything is said.
starting_positions.simulated-human: Presents a coherent version of a possible future.

trigger: The press conference is scheduled, but the human whose future is being announced is absent. The team builds a simulated version to answer questions.
constraints: A deadline for the press conference.
Conflicting standards for what counts as a truthful announcement.
Do not tell the characters what the ending should be.
exit_condition: The room decides what to announce, or admits it cannot, in a way a new listener can tell apart from an actual event.
dramatic_objective: Make the audience understand the difference between a coherent simulation and an actual event.

variations.start: The simulation admits it does not know what happened
Two simulations disagree about the same future
